race.comment: Open race to close out the card. MONGOLIAN SPRING (8) got the maiden out of the way at Grafton last time out and will have taken a lot from that breakthrough victory. Should get some cover in running from gate six and can go right on with the job now. I AM VOODOO (1) loves this course and distance with six wins and 12 placings from 23 starts. Include with the 3kg claim. ANDI DON'T CARE (3) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race of this calibre. Can run a big race while fresh. QICKWIT (7) is ready to peak now third run back and is another to get some weight relief. In the mix. SUM INVICTUS (6) next best out of the astute Goldman camp.
